operations.rationale: CREATE a unified boundary-aware inspector because the parent is empty. The program learns definition/list propagation, exclusion introductions, endpoint-triggered disposition chains, grammatical lead-ins, scoped recipient classes, and exact operative verbs from the supplied Gold sources. Cases 147, 319, 136, and 114 motivate cross-span definition/list handling; 89, 245, 431, and 583 motivate endpoint, retention, and survival separation; 314, 384, 616, and 202 motivate exact conduct, provenance, recipient-class, and compelled-notice matching.
